title: Two files disagree: ambiguous, a quote for each side, no pick
about: The SmPC says 18 months and the stability report says 24 months. The manufacture file says Building B and the quality overall summary says Building D. The other four facts agree.

pages:
Summary of Product Characteristics (draft, sections 1 to 6)

1. Name of the medicinal product

Tavorix 100 mg tablets

2. Qualitative and quantitative composition

Each tablet contains 100 mg of tavorix sodium.

3. Pharmaceutical form

Film-coated tablet. White, oval, biconvex tablets.

6.3 Shelf life

The shelf life of the medicinal product is 18 months.

6.4 Special precautions for storage

Do not store above 25 C. Store in the original package in order to protect from moisture.

6.5 Nature and contents of container

Alu/Alu blisters in cartons of 28 tablets.

Stability report: Tavorix 100 mg tablets

Contents

3.2.P.8.1 Stability summary and conclusion ........ page 2
3.2.P.8.3 Stability data ........ page 3

3.2.P.8.1 Stability summary and conclusion

Three primary batches of Tavorix 100 mg tablets were placed on stability in the proposed commercial pack. All results stayed within specification at every time point. Based on these data, a shelf life of 24 months is proposed when the product is stored below 25 C in the original package.

3.2.P.8.3 Stability data

Table 1. Storage conditions and duration of data

| Study | Storage condition | Temperature (C) | Relative humidity (%) | Months of data |
| Long-term | 25 C / 60% RH | 25 | 60 | 12 |
| Accelerated | 40 C / 75% RH | 40 | 75 | 6 |

The long-term study was stored at 25 C / 60% RH. 12 months of long-term data are available for all three batches.

3.2.P.3 Manufacture

3.2.P.3.1 Manufacturer(s)

The finished product is manufactured, packaged, tested and released at Northgate Medicines, Building B, 5 Foundry Street, Kelmarsh.

3.2.P.3.3 Description of manufacturing process

Direct compression of the blend, followed by tablet compression, film coating and blister packing. In-process controls are listed in section 3.2.P.3.4.

2.3 Quality Overall Summary

This summary follows the structure of Module 3 for Tavorix 100 mg tablets.

2.3.S Drug substance

The drug substance is supplied by an approved manufacturer, with details in Module 3.2.S. It is a white to off-white crystalline powder.

2.3.P.3 Manufacture

The finished product is manufactured and released at the Northgate Medicines facility, Building D, 5 Foundry Street, Kelmarsh. Tablets are packed in Alu/Alu blisters.

2.3.P.8 Stability

The stability data are summarised in Module 3.2.P.8.
